message: `Ball.position` belongs to the physics subsystem, because 'Ball' has a Dynamic body, so it cannot be assigned.
notes: the solver owns the pose of a dynamic body; move it with `apply_impulse`, `apply_force`, `set_linear_velocity` or `teleport`
